More critically, in the previous attempts, I may have rushed to the "gap" method without rigorously checking if the "closed after" time creates a hard boundary that eliminates options I thought were valid. Next time, I will explicitly list every minute of the day, mark every observed activity with its exact start and end times, and then identify the *only* continuous interval where the person is unobserved AND the location is open, ensuring the selected option perfectly matches that specific interval without any overlap with observed activities. I will double-check the start/end times of the observations against the option boundaries before selecting.
